title: On ECINet platform, access for States can be switched off and on centrally: report
shows: Reports a second finding from Saurav Rajput's review of ECINET's code for the civic-tech initiative Charchagram. The portal has an area for managing State Nodal Officers with a disable button on each, and the code carries a message for States where viewing enumeration form details is not enabled. The review read only code the site serves before login, and the report does not say who can use either control or whether either was used.
quote: Each SNO row has a disable button and the disable pop-up says: “On disabling this State Nodal Officer, the user will no longer be able to access the application.”
While it was not clear since when this feature was available on ECINet, it might be recalled that the portal itself was launched in January 2026.
